title: Site square for the canonical candidate compositor on a Cartesian tower
statement: For a finite-field datum F and a finite commutative coefficient ring A, let X,V,W,Y,B,Z be objects of Spaces F of [def-sf-composition-projection-data]. Let j:X -> V, b:V -> W, i:Y -> B be open immersions with b and i quasi-compact, and q:V -> Y, p:W -> B, s:B -> Z proper, such that b p = q i is Cartesian. Use the factor compactifications c_f=(j,q), c_g=(i,s), c_gf=(j b,p s) of [def-sf-operation-stages]. For E in D+(X_et,A), an arbitrary object K of the full bounded-below etale-origin category, and an isomorphism e:N(E) -> K in that full category, let C_K be candidateCompositor of [def-sf-cartesian-candidate-compositor], the four-factor conjugation of originCompositionAmbient by towerCandidateComparison on c_f,c_g,c_gf, as in [thm-sf-comp-composition, def-sf-origin-candidate-comparison]. Write AE, B and D for the independent etale tower and site word comparisons of [lem-sp-finite-site-tower-paste], and S_E,T_E for the concrete source/output D+ inclusion isomorphisms of [lem-sf-cartesian-tower-restriction]. Then inclusion(N(AE(E))) followed by inclusion(B_gf(E)), T_E and the c_gf functor applied to e equals inclusion(D(E)) followed by S_E, the composite c_g c_f functor applied to e, and C_K. There is no raw clopen alpha in this statement.

proof.text: Use etale_compositor_normalization on the factor compactifications (j,q), (i,s), (j b,p s). Its etale arrow AE is the restriction of the normalized unbounded etale compact-support compositor; unboundedEtaleCompactSupport_composition_plus identifies this restriction with the canonical bounded-below etale compositor.

Evaluate the fully faithful preimage defining originCompositionAmbient and each towerCandidateComparison on the comparison image of E. Each candidate change is the etale common-refinement change conjugated by its two specified site comparisons. The canonical compact-support site-coherence square, naturality at the inner candidate change, and the candidate-change cocycle cancel adjacent boundaries.

Expand the remaining site comparisons into proper counit mates and open site isomorphisms. On the comparison image the input is D followed by sourceInclusion, and the output is B followed by targetInclusion. For the specified full-origin isomorphism e:N(E) -> K, paste the four naturality squares for the inner candidate comparison, outer comparison, origin composition and final comparison. They move the source-functor image of e to the input boundary and its output-functor image to the output boundary. This gives the asserted square at K.

theorem cartesianCandidateSiteSquare
    (F : WeilConjectures.FiniteFieldDatum.{u})
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X V W Y B Z : Spaces F}
    (j : X ⟶ V) (b : V ⟶ W) (q : V ⟶ Y) (p : W ⟶ B) (i : Y ⟶ B) (s : B ⟶ Z)
    [IsOpenImmersion ((geometry F).map j)] [IsOpenImmersion ((geometry F).map b)]
    [IsOpenImmersion ((geometry F).map i)] [QuasiCompact ((geometry F).map b)]
    [QuasiCompact ((geometry F).map i)]
    [IsProper ((geometry F).map q)] [IsProper ((geometry F).map p)]
    [IsProper ((geometry F).map s)]
    (hb : b ≫ p = q ≫ i)
    (sq : IsPullback b.hom.left q.hom.left p.hom.left i.hom.left)
    (E : FiniteSiteTower.DE A X.obj.left)
    (K : (DerivedCategory.plusEtaleOrigin (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
      X.obj.left).FullSubcategory)
    (e : (comparisonUpperStarPlusEtaleOrigin (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X.obj.left).obj E ≅ K) :
    letI : IsOpenImmersion j.hom.left := ‹IsOpenImmersion ((geometry F).map j)›
    letI : IsOpenImmersion b.hom.left := ‹IsOpenImmersion ((geometry F).map b)›
    letI : IsOpenImmersion i.hom.left := ‹IsOpenImmersion ((geometry F).map i)›
    letI : QuasiCompact b.hom.left := ‹QuasiCompact ((geometry F).map b)›
    letI : QuasiCompact i.hom.left := ‹QuasiCompact ((geometry F).map i)›
    letI : IsProper q.hom.left := ‹IsProper ((geometry F).map q)›
    letI : IsProper p.hom.left := ‹IsProper ((geometry F).map p)›
    letI : IsProper s.hom.left := ‹IsProper ((geometry F).map s)›
    letI : IsOpenImmersion (j ≫ b).hom.left :=
      mappedCompositeOpen (geo := geometry F) j b
    letI : IsProper (p ≫ s).hom.left := mappedCompositeProper (geo := geometry F) p s
    let cf := WeilConjectures.sixFunctorFactorCompactification j q
      ‹IsOpenImmersion ((geometry F).map j)› ‹IsProper ((geometry F).map q)›
      (j ≫ q) rfl
    let cg := WeilConjectures.sixFunctorFactorCompactification i s
      ‹IsOpenImmersion ((geometry F).map i)› ‹IsProper ((geometry F).map s)›
      (i ≫ s) rfl
    let cfg := WeilConjectures.sixFunctorFactorCompactification (j ≫ b) (p ≫ s)
      (mappedCompositeOpen (geo := geometry F) j b)
      (mappedCompositeProper (geo := geometry F) p s) ((j ≫ q) ≫ (i ≫ s)) (by
        simp only [Category.assoc]
        rw [← Category.assoc q i s, ← hb]
        simp only [Category.assoc])
    let C := ProjectionTriangleAssembly.candidateCompositor A cf cg cfg K
    DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.map
        ((FiniteSiteTower.N A Z.obj.left).map
          (FiniteSiteTower.AE A j.hom.left b.hom.left p.hom.left s.hom.left i.hom.left
            q.hom.left sq E)) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.map
        (FiniteSiteTower.B A (j ≫ b).hom.left (p ≫ s).hom.left E) ≫
      (CartesianTower.targetInclusion A (j ≫ b).hom.left (p ≫ s).hom.left
        ((FiniteSiteTower.N A X.obj.left).obj E)).hom ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) cfg).map e.hom.hom =
    DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.map
        (FiniteSiteTower.D A j.hom.left s.hom.left i.hom.left q.hom.left E) ≫
      (CartesianTower.sourceInclusion A j.hom.left q.hom.left i.hom.left s.hom.left
        ((FiniteSiteTower.N A X.obj.left).obj E)).hom ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) cg).map
        ((rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) cf).map
          e.hom.hom) ≫ C
